summary: Run 3 (fixed :3170, build 3c1404e37c): staged applied=aeb05fa8e4 (sha256 of a probe label; absent from adv_sessions 31144 launch_spec and all 12 identityHistory receipts), desired=4a51d5cfe1 (= launch record revision). One coord:glance call returned ok; the activation was status=applied, applied=desired=4a51d5cfe1 immediately after, and no SQL fallback ran. Run 4 (control, :3070, build 7708e704d9, which lacks healStaleArtifactFromLaunchRecord): the identical staged state was denied 'Kernel preflight denied tool "coord:glance": Identity capability (unresolved): stale-artifact' and the activation stayed desired/aeb05fa8e4 until the documented SQL converge. The only variable between the two runs is the serving build.

assertions.evidence: H2/K2: status=desired, applied=aeb05fa8e4, desired=4a51d5cfe1. The unadmitted revision matches 0 of the record's 13 receipts (record + identityHistory), so resolveIdentityArtifact returns stale-artifact/receipt-missing; run 4 shows the unfixed gate deny exactly that.

H3: coord:glance via :3170 exit 0, tool_invocations 16:41:57.073Z coord:glance ok serving_build_sha=3c1404e37c. H4 (16:41:57.162Z): status=applied, applied=desired=4a51d5cfe1. No H5 fallback line: the convergence was written by the gate.

K3: coord:glance via :3070 exit 1, 'authorization_denied: Kernel preflight denied tool "coord:glance": Identity capability (unresolved): stale-artifact'; tool_invocations 16:42:14.358Z coord:glance error serving_build_sha=7708e704d9. K4: still desired/aeb05fa8e4; K5 SQL converge required.
K6 (16:42:14.708Z): status=applied, applied=desired=4a51d5cfe1, control_generation 77 unchanged across all runs.

notProven: Runs 1 and 2 in the scratch log staged applied=76ad97bab2, which IS admitted by identityHistory, so the gate correctly resolved 'governed' and allowed without healing; they are NOT evidence either way and are retained only as the record of a mis-staged probe.

A natural carry-respawn reaching this state on its own: this is a staged reproduction of the not-admitted-applied condition the heal targets. Natural fleet-wide absence of startup stale-artifact denials after the fix deploys to :3070 is a separate post-deploy reading.
The :3070 release operator: it does not yet carry the fix (main is held by the frozen repair queue); this observation is on the staging operator.

steps: Read: control_state.activation must be status=applied with applied=desired=launch_spec.specificationRevision.
Stage (guarded on that exact state): applied.specificationRevision := a revision absent from launch_spec and launch_spec.identityHistory; status := 'desired'; prepared := null.
Call coord:glance through the target port with --client <owner>.
Read control_state.activation and tool_invocations since T0.
If status != applied, converge: applied := desired, prepared := desired, status := 'applied' WHERE desired = launch record revision.
